summary_md: **Jorge Miranda Cherem ([@jorge0018](https://x.com/jorge0018/status/2116131594452767123))** releases **Hotbox** for ComfyUI, a context-aware action menu opened with the backtick key, inspired by Maya's Hotbox and Nuke's W_hotbox ([jorge-miranda-cherem/comfyui-hotbox](https://github.com/jorge-miranda-cherem/comfyui-hotbox)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - jorge-miranda-cherem/comfyui-hotbox: A fast, Nuke/Maya-style context-aware hotbox for ComyUI: smart auto-wiring, model swapping, drag-to-pin ars, pro sliders, Super Stitch and visual crop/painteditors. Frontend only.

relevance: ComfyUI usability tool from VFX conventions.
